from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u068/system/state/workspace/programs/task-bba7836b.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    markers = sum(v == 4 for row in grid for v in row)
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    return [row * markers for row in shape]
'''
